definition: caiso-197 WAVE-2 FINAL RUNG +L5: the full surviving ladder — lane-2 three-field move + lane-3 cited override + lane-5 six-plant cited-physical PS — on the re-anchored caiso-196 base (integration protocol §1; all three lanes ACCEPTED on their pre-registered gates before composition). One mechanism added vs the previous rung (caiso197_w2_r3).
market_story: CC_REGULAR: the class runs on its measured CEMS outage overlay alone — the statistical WEFOR term that double-counted the same >=5-day events is retired (wefor_residual=0.0 on the 96.7%-observed class), so gas CC serves the net-load ramp at the availability the fleet actually had, and the class's annual energy sits in band without a fitted compensation. ST_GAS: the 1958-73 coastal steamers (Alamitos, Huntington Beach, Ormond Beach) are available at their published NERC-GADS class EFORd (0.1591, size-class-weighted from CAISO's own census) instead of an ERCOT-fitted crush — intermediate-duty steam clears when the margin prices it in, at the outage rate the GADS record says such units really run. PUMPED STORAGE: Helms, Gianelli, Hyatt, Thermalito, O'Neill and Eastwood cycle within their cited physics — pump-side motor ratings (Helms 930 MW, Gianelli 375.8 MW bind below the generating ratings) and reservoir energy bounds spanning Thermalito's 4.5 GWh afterbay cycle to San Luis's seasonal 613 GWh — so the LP's arbitrage is bounded by the water infrastructure the real market schedules around, not a fleet-average 10-hour battery.
